% Shared normative core: definitions
\section{Normative scientific definitions}
\label{sec:definitions}

\subsection{Method and estimand}

\ContractID{} is an optimal matched-template amplitude estimator only under
the exact criterion and premises in Section~\ref{sec:optimality}. It estimates
the local amplitude of one exact declared template in one immutable admitted
ordinary-MAP parent. It publishes a filtered amplitude map. It does not
detect, select, fit, deblend, catalog, classify, or interpret sources, and it
is neither posterior/Wiener sky reconstruction nor ordinary convolution.

Each realization has the immutable scientific identity
\begin{quote}\small\ttfamily\raggedright
(method\_id, estimand, parent\_id, parent\_grouping, domain, WCS/frame,
template\_id, state\_generation, weighting\_object, operator\_realization,
approximation, response, support/null, units/calibration, covariance,
NOI\_lifecycle, product\_bundle, validity, failure\_policy, provenance).
\end{quote}
Any scientifically consequential change to one of these fields creates a
different realization, generation, or method as classified by the selected
\AO{002} and \AO{004} dispositions.

\subsection{Parent classes and application locality}

Exactly one of two parent classes is admitted per application:
\begin{enumerate}
  \item one immutable normalized ordinary-MAP observation bundle; or
  \item one immutable normalized ordinary-MAP coadd bundle with its exact
  contributing-observation membership.
\end{enumerate}
They are distinct local applications. This contract asserts no equality,
commutation, or interchangeability between ``filter then coadd'' and ``coadd
then filter'', and owns no coaddition. JINC and other derived parents are not
admitted. Numerical computability cannot repair a parent that lacks required
MAP authority.

\subsection{Template-response product}

Each application has exactly one immutable template-response product. It is
scientifically declared outside target, source, candidate, population, and
NOI-member learning. The product binds its materialized samples, amplitude
scaling, anchor and phase convention, parent-map response quantity, WCS/frame,
sampling, support, CAL/BEAM lineage, validity, and generation. Template
mismatch is not silently absorbed into amplitude uncertainty or estimator
normalization.

\subsection{Influence support and validity}

The influence support at $x$ is the complete set of parent samples on which
$N(x)$, $D(x)$, the realized $Q_x$, the template, any window, and any declared
nonlocal operation depend. A location is admitted only if that complete set is
available and valid. No partial-support estimator, edge renormalization,
extension, imputation, background subtraction, learned taper, or
signal-derived support belongs to this contract. Numerical fill values may be
used internally only after exact erosion proves that no admitted output
depends on them. Affected locations are \Unavailable{}, not zero.

\subsection{Weighting and parent coefficients}

$Q_x$ is a declared frozen weighting object chosen from a later
owner-disposed \AO{001} alternative. A parent coefficient has only its exact
declared role in that alternative. Its name, positivity, units, reciprocal,
or diagonal placement does not make it covariance, precision, independence,
or inverse variance. Rank, null space, regularization, support, edge behavior,
state population, and units are part of $Q_x$ identity.

\subsection{Frozen state and generations}

Requested, effective, observation-resolved, realized, and published state are
distinct objects and shall retain distinct identities and provenance even when
some fields happen to be numerically equal.

For generation $g$,
\[
 \mathrm{state}_g =
 \operatorname{DeclareOrLearnOnce}(\mathrm{parent}_g,
                                   \mathrm{external\ inputs}_g),\qquad
 \mathrm{product}_g =
 \operatorname{Apply}(\mathrm{parent}_g;\mathrm{state}_g).
\]
State is externally declared or learned once from the exact parent and then
frozen. Observation and coadd states are separate. Every compatible NOI
realization member receives exactly the same frozen transformation, support,
normalization, and failure rules. NOI-informed updating produces an immutable
successor generation. Per-member relearning is a different future method and
is unavailable here.

\subsection{Fixed-state response}

The response is the complete fixed-state map $R_t(x,y)=L_xt_y$. It may be
asymmetric, anisotropic, nonstationary, position-dependent, or nonlocal. A
single response kernel, radial profile, beam, or solid angle is scientifically
sufficient only when every invariance and measure needed for that reduction
has been established. Matching-template unit response at admitted positions
does not establish fidelity to other morphologies.

\subsection{Product roles and atomic lifecycle}
\label{sec:product-roles}

The required atomic signal bundle contains, as one role-complete unit:
\begin{enumerate}
  \item the filtered amplitude field and its quantity and units;
  \item exact parent identity, class, generation, grouping, WCS/frame,
  coadd membership when applicable, support, and parent provenance;
  \item template identity, amplitude convention, response reference, and
  CAL/BEAM lineage;
  \item method, state generation, $Q_x$, operator realization,
  approximation identity, support/null rules, and validity mask;
  \item uncertainty availability and the identity of any qualified companion;
  and
  \item lifecycle state, failure semantics, producer identity, and complete
  lineage needed to distinguish or reconstruct the realization.
\end{enumerate}
Failure of any member fails the whole signal bundle.

Independently atomic qualified companions may represent authorized
$C_{\rm cond}$, a frozen-NOI uncertainty estimand, response materialization,
or exact state/lineage required by a named use. Each companion has its own
estimand, population, unit, support, validity, lifecycle, and policy. Its
absence or failure is explicit and does not alter the signal estimand or
retroactively invalidate a complete signal bundle unless an exact named-use
policy requires it.

No numerator, denominator, kernel, PSD, response slice, inverse scale,
standardized field, or intermediate is a public science product without an
exact role, meaning, unit, validity, lifecycle, and policy.

\subsection{Lifecycle states}

\begin{longtable}{p{0.18\linewidth}p{0.72\linewidth}}
\toprule
State & Meaning \\
\midrule
\endhead
\Disabled{} & The method or qualified product was explicitly not requested;
there is no attempted estimand. \\
\Unavailable{} & A required scientific premise, authority, input, selected
option, or valid support is absent; no numerical value is asserted. \\
\Failed{} & An authorized attempt began but a required operation, closure
check, or atomic member failed. \\
\Complete{} & Every required member and predicate for the exact role and
generation is present and passed; this is not a performance or readiness
claim. \\
\Superseded{} & An immutable successor exists. The predecessor remains
identifiable and is not silently rewritten. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\subsection{First-class FLT to FRUIT handoff}

The product lineage shall let a future separately authorized FRUIT method
consume the filtered amplitude product without reconstructing undocumented
FLT implementation state. At minimum it identifies the filtered quantity,
template, full response reference, valid support, units/calibration,
method/state identity, uncertainty availability, and provenance. Additional
authorized FLT state shall be exactly available or reconstructable through
lineage. This handoff defines no FRUIT source model, subtraction/add-back,
recurrence, learning, stopping, restart, selection, response, uncertainty, or
interpretation.

\subsection{Authority layers}

This document is scientific authority for definitions and requirements after
owner disposition and freeze. An implementation may later claim conformity
only through auditable evidence against a selected contract. Validation may
evaluate immutable profiles but does not invent producer facts or policy.
Measured behavior is achieved performance, not scientific authority.
Readiness and production are separate governance decisions. No draft, option,
test result, or lifecycle state collapses these layers.

\subsection{Producer and boundary ownership}

\begin{longtable}{p{0.18\linewidth}p{0.72\linewidth}}
\toprule
Owner & Normative boundary \\
\midrule
\endhead
FLT / \ContractID{} & Owns the template-amplitude transformation, declared
template use, learn-once state definition and realization, resulting response
and support consequences, product roles, lifecycle, failure semantics,
named-use policies, fixed transformation supplied to compatible NOI members,
and preservation of the FLT to FRUIT handoff. \\
MAP & Owns the immutable admitted parent map bundle, generation, grouping,
WCS/frame, support/validity, signal quantity and unit, response/calibration
provenance, and exact contributing-observation membership of a coadd. FLT may
consume but not rewrite these facts. \\
Template producer & Owns the exact immutable materialized template-response
product, including scale, phase, anchor, sampling, support, lineage, and
validity. \\
CAL/BEAM & Own calibrated transfer, amplitude-convention inputs, beam lineage,
and calibration covariance. FLT owns only their declared use and the resulting
template-amplitude response. \\
NOI & Owns realization generation and empirical-uncertainty meanings. FLT owns
the identical frozen transformation applied to compatible members. \\
VAL & May register and evaluate exact immutable profiles. FLT owns the producer
facts, named-use policies, required actions, and failure consequences; VAL may
not invent them. \\
FRUIT & Owns any future source model, subtraction/add-back, recurrence,
learning, stopping/restart/selection, response, uncertainty, and interpretation.
FLT owns only preservation of the first-class scientific handoff. \\
SRC & No present ownership boundary or dependency is created; source analysis
is outside scope. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
